fields: as a versus table: cols [test, FAT label, SAT label] (the two labels also tag the drawing's boundaries), rows [[test, FAT cell, SAT cell]] (strings or {t, link}), conclusion [label, FAT side, SAT side], fold, fold_noun (the fold applies on phones only), row_parts (optional, one string per row: space-separated drawing parts the test covers, any of skid, ro, pump, panel, inst, valve, pipe, tank, loop, pou, util).
best_for: VersusSpread sets a FAT versus SAT table as an editorial spread: a navy mast with the heading at display scale, the numbered comparison table, and one line drawing of the installed system whose parts light for the test being read (look `versus-spread`, table block `as: "versus"`).
